title: Super Micro-Backed AI Firm Bags $7.8 Billion Deals With Nvidia Chips in Demand
title_zh: 超微支持的人工智能公司与 Nvidia 芯片达成 78 亿美元交易
summary: Argentum AI, which is backed by Super Micro Computer, has agreed deals to deploy 47,000 Nvidia GB300 chips.
summary_zh: 由 Super Micro Computer 支持的 Argentum AI 已同意部署 47,000 颗 Nvidia GB300 芯片。

title: Jim Cramer Discusses Big Salesforce (CRM) Deal
title_zh: Jim Cramer 讨论大型 Salesforce (CRM) 交易
summary: We recently published Jim Cramer Discussed Expensive Phones, A Cheap Stock Sector & These 18 Stocks. Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) is one of the stocks discussed by Jim Cramer. Customer relationship management software products provider Salesforce, Inc.
summary_zh: 我们最近发表了吉姆·克莱默讨论昂贵的手机、廉价的股票行业和这 18 只股票。 Salesforce, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：CRM）是 Jim Cramer 讨论的股票之一。客户关系管理软件产品提供商 Salesforce, Inc.

title: Micron stock hits an all-time high, thanks to the new Anthropic deal
title_zh: 得益于新的 Anthropic 交易，美光股价创下历史新高
summary: Micron (MU) stock hit a new all-time high on Monday after the company's deal with Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) was announced. Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré takes a closer look in the video above.
summary_zh: 在宣布与 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 达成交易后，美光 (MU) 股价周一创下历史新高。雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 在上面的视频中仔细观察。

title: Amazon Prime Day to spark online spending frenzy as Walmart, Target lean into deal days
title_zh: 沃尔玛、塔吉特纷纷进入促销日，亚马逊 Prime Day 引发在线消费狂潮
summary: Amazon Prime Days kick off on Tuesday. Walmart, Target, and Best Buy are competing for a piece of the pie.
summary_zh: 亚马逊 Prime Day 将于周二拉开帷幕。沃尔玛、塔吉特和百思买正在争夺这块蛋糕。

title: AbbVie's $10.9 Billion Apogee Deal Joins a $200 Billion Pharma Spree
title_zh: 艾伯维 (AbbVie) 109 亿美元的 Apogee 交易加入了 2000 亿美元的制药热潮
summary: The $135.11 per share cash offer for Apogee carries a 49% premium
summary_zh: Apogee 每股 135.11 美元的现金收购要约溢价 49%
